content: Three.js CDN usage: official pattern is importmap mapping both 'three' and 'three/addons/' to the SAME pinned pinned-version URL (cdn.jsdelivr.net or unpkg); mixing versions between the two map entries yields two THREE instances and instanceof failures. UMD build no longer exists (r150+); old script-tag tutorials are dead. From ~r167-180 the module build splits: build/three.module.js imports './three.core.js', so vendoring must copy the whole build dir, not one file. Verified via package.json exports of three@0.170.0 and r180 module import graph over network.
